comment: The Fold row's gate and CV inputs and its enable and attenuverter parameters have no control on the panel; the Fold Frequency slider is on the menu. The two source menu items are printed with the source in use after the name, as Source 1: Rack and Source 2: Image, so the name changes with the setting. The rotation, translate X, translate Y and hue rows wrap their knob-plus-CV total rather than clamping it (PortaloofModule.hpp:685), so no sumRange is written for those four CV jacks. A gate jack only has an effect while a cable is in it: PortaloofModule.hpp:676 treats an unpatched gate as permanently on and leaves the row to its button.
